definitions.explanation: The breaking or severing of a wire, cable, or electrical line, causing a loss of connection or power.

examples.japanese: ⟦ケーブル→ケーブル：04432_keeburu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{断線|だんせん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦イヤホン→イヤホン：04421_iyahon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{断線|だんせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{片方|かたほう}→片方：03044_katahou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}なく→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Due to a broken wire in the earphones, sound stopped coming from one side.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{送電線|そうでんせん}→送電線：09776_soudensen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{断線|だんせん}し、⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{範囲|はんい}→範囲：03567_hani⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{停電|ていでん}→停電：03544_teiden⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}した→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
examples.english: Due to the typhoon, power lines were severed, causing widespread power outages.

notes:
Composed of {断|だん} (sever/cut) + ⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧ (line/wire). Refers to the physical breaking of a wire or cable, whether in small electronics or large infrastructure.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {断線|だんせん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to break/disconnect (as a verb with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧)
- ⟦ケーブル→ケーブル：04432_keeburu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{断線|だんせん}: cable breakage
- ⟦{送電線|そうでんせん}→送電線：09776_soudensen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{断線|だんせん}: power line break
- {断線|だんせん}⟦{箇所|かしょ}→箇所：00196_kasho⟧: point of disconnection
- {断線|だんせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to repair a broken wire

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{切断|せつだん}→切断：20497_setsudan⟧: severance, cutting — a more general term for cutting, not limited to wires
- ⟦{停電|ていでん}→停電：03544_teiden⟧: power outage — the result of power line {断線|だんせん}, but can also be caused by other factors
- ⟦{接触不良|せっしょくふりょう}→接触不良：16550_sesshokufuryou⟧: poor contact — a different type of electrical problem where the wire is not broken but the connection is loose

USAGE:
In everyday life, {断線|だんせん} most commonly occurs with earphone/headphone cables and charging cables. It is also used in news reports about damage from natural disasters.
